prompt: List the main components of this repository as JSON {"files": [...]} naming one representative file per component
truth_source: hand-curated by the leaf 1.5.6 bench agent, verified against source at e2740d5a1bd0b4254e517e3af8b60789284bc7bd. Curation rule: one file per component of hono's runtime surface, where a component is either a top-level module under src/ that src/index.ts re-exports (hono.ts the Hono application class, router.ts the Router interface and method constants, context.ts the per-request Context, request.ts HonoRequest, compose.ts the koa-style middleware composer, http-exception.ts HTTPException) or a directory under src/ that publishes its own entry file (src/jsx/index.ts the JSX runtime, src/client/index.ts the RPC client `hc`, src/validator/index.ts the `validator` middleware). src/adapter/, src/helper/, src/middleware/ and src/preset/ are deliberately excluded: each is a collection of independent opt-in modules with no entry file of its own, so any single representative would be an arbitrary pick the scorer could not defend. src/hono-base.ts is excluded because src/hono.ts is the same component (Hono extends HonoBase) and the prompt asks for one file per component.
